basic_info.description: Sunny and beautiful. Renovated top floor view 1BR/1BA Plus an office TIC in a 4 unit building in the Inner Sunset with garage parking, steps   away to Irving restaurants and nearby Golden Gate Park. New open-concept kitchen equipped with dishwasher, quartz countertops, electric stove and oven, power vent hood, microwave and a ful-sized fridge. Bathroom with double walk-in shower and dual head faucets. Spacious   bedroom with enough room for a king-sized bed and desk plus oversized closet. One car deeded parking in garage plus additional space for   your items in a storage room. Walking distance to a foodies paradise with excellent dining options like Tartine, Fiorela, San Tung, Rose   Indian, Sriracha, Arizmendi bakery, and more! 5-minute walk to Grand View Park and community gardens, 10-minute walk to Golden Gate   Park.
